HttpService (e2e) leaves a stream respon: deliberate difference: @nestjs/axios never aborts a responseType: 'stream' request on unsubscribe, however much of the response has arrived; this package aborts a still-pending stream request (headers not yet emitted) on unsubscribe to free the connection, and only stops aborting once the stream itself has been handed to the subscriber. See plan.md 'upstream conformance suites'.
HttpModule register assigns a distinct m: harness limitation: HTTP_MODULE_ID is a random per-registration id in both packages, but a different shape (21-char nanoid upstream vs. this package's 36-char randomUUID()); nothing in the public contract promises a specific id length or alphabet, so this assertion can't transfer as-is.
HttpModule registerAsync resolves the op: harness limitation: this test reads AXIOS_INSTANCE_TOKEN's value as an axios instance (.defaults.timeout); this package's nearest equivalent, UNDICI_INSTANCE_TOKEN, carries raw undici dispatcher options instead, not an axios-like object with .defaults. The shim (shims/http-constants.js) aliases the token so the DI graph still resolves, but this particular assertion has no equivalent to transfer to.
